items.impact: It is a big loss for the Giants secondary. It is unclear if he will require surgery.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: New York Giants D/ST rattle Jags in win
items.desc: The New York Giants D/ST racked up three sacks and two interceptions in the team's 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: Abdul Carter and the Giants were pressuring Lawrence all afternoon, giving the powerful Jags offense little space to work. They will get a great matchup against the Colts next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Dominic Zvada goes for 11 kicking points in win over Jags
items.desc: Dominic Zvada hit both of his PATs and three of four field goal attempts in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: Zvada had a miss in this game, but thankfully for him it was not a deciding factor for this game, though it could have been had things fallen differently. He's now missed four field goal attempts in his last four games, so the Giants could start entertaining new names for the job.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Devin Singletary quiet in win over Jags
items.desc: Devin Singletary ran once for five yards and caught his only target for five yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jags on Sunday.
items.impact: Singletary was a distant second to Cam Skattebo in running back attempts and targets in this game, and irrelevant for fantasy. It will likely stay that way unless Skattebo is punished for his fumbling issues.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Malachi Fields snags two passes in win
items.desc: Malachi Fields caught two of five targets for 25 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: Fields had a couple of nice grabs in this contest, but didn't do much for fantasy purposes. He's not worth rostering for fantasy right now, with Malik Nabers and Isaiah Likely taking so much of the work.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Isaiah Likely drops touchdown in win over Jags
items.desc: Isaiah Likely caught one of three targets for 35 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: If nothing else, at least Likely's one catch was a big gain. However, he dropped a sure-fire touchdown from Jameis Winston, which would have greatly helped his fantasy day. He will look to bounce back against Indianapolis next week.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Raiders D/ST allows 31 offensive points in Week 11
items.desc: The Raiders' defense surrendered 351 total yards, while recording one sack and one interception in Las Vegas' 38-24 loss to Denver in Week 11.
items.impact: The Broncos scored 38 points, seven of which came via a Ja'Quan McMillian pick-six and the ensuing extra point. Las Vegas intercepted Bo Nix but allowed Jonah Coleman to rush for 111 yards and three touchdowns. One sack and one takeaway weren't enough to offset the points allowed. The Raiders D/ST remains difficult to trust in fantasy heading into Week 12 against Cleveland.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Matt Gay makes all four kicks in Week 11
items.desc: Matt Gay converted his lone field-goal attempt and all three extra-point attempts in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
items.impact: Gay connected from 28 yards out in the second quarter after a would-be touchdown to Jalen Nailor was negated by a penalty. The veteran kicker was listed as questionable entering Sunday with a right hip injury but converted all four of his kicks. He'll get the Browns on the road in Week 12.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Ian Thomas scores touchdown in Week 11
items.desc: Ian Thomas caught his only target for a 19-yard touchdown in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
items.impact: Thomas caught Fernando Mendoza's second career touchdown pass, tying the game at 17 in the third quarter. Brock Bowers was inactive, while Michael Mayer exited Sunday's game with an injury. Thomas could see additional opportunities if both tight ends miss Week 12, but he's only worth considering in deeper tight end-premium leagues at this juncture.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Michael Mayer exits Week 11 with injury
items.desc: Michael Mayer caught one of four targets for four yards before exiting the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11 with an injury.
items.impact: Mayer had an opportunity to fill in for Brock Bowers, who was inactive Sunday with ankle and quadriceps injuries. The former, however, also exited the game, leaving Ian Thomas to pick up some of the slack. Thomas caught a 19-yard touchdown. Mayer's injury designation and availability for Week 12 against Cleveland will need to be monitored.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Jalen Nailor held to one reception in Week 11
items.desc: Jalen Nailor caught one of five targets for 16 yards in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
items.impact: Nailor had two would-be touchdowns negated by penalties Sunday. The former came via offensive pass interference, while Fernando Mendoza crossed the line of scrimmage before throwing the latter. So, the box score doesn't tell the entire story here. That said, Nailor remains difficult to start with Jack Bech and Tre Tucker combining for 19 targets.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Tre Tucker sees 10 targets in Week 11
items.desc: Tre Tucker caught two of 10 targets for 50 yards in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
items.impact: Tucker led Las Vegas with 10 targets but caught just 20% of them. And 39 of his 50 receiving yards came on one reception. Meanwhile, Jack Bech caught eight of nine targets for 88 yards and a touchdown. The opportunities were there for Tucker in Fernando Mendoza's second career start, but the lack of efficiency makes him a volatile starting piece in fantasy lineups.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Jack Bech records 88 yards and a touchdown in Week 11
items.desc: Jack Bech caught eight of nine targets for 88 yards and one touchdown in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
items.impact: With Brock Bowers inactive, Bech led Las Vegas with eight receptions and accounted for a third of Fernando Mendoza's passing yards. He also caught a seven-yard touchdown in the fourth quarter. Tre Tucker saw one more target than Bech but caught six fewer passes. It'll be interesting to see if Bech can sustain this level of involvement once Bowers returns. The second-year receiver is worth adding off waivers.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Mike Washington Jr. rushes for 42 yards in Week 11
items.desc: Mike Washington Jr. rushed nine times for 42 yards in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
items.impact: Washington averaged 4.7 yards per carry and had just two fewer carries than Ashton Jeanty. The difference? Jeanty saw eight targets, catching five passes for 90 yards and a touchdown, while Washington wasn't targeted. The rookie warrants a roster spot as Jeanty's handcuff but isn't a reliable standalone fantasy option.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Ashton Jeanty totals 169 yards and a touchdown in Week 11
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty rushed 11 times for 79 yards while catching five of eight targets for 90 yards and one touchdown in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
items.impact: Jeanty had a season-long 46-yard run and caught a 68-yard touchdown from Fernando Mendoza. More importantly, the latter was Jeanty's fourth receiving touchdown of the season. Mike Washington Jr. had nine carries compared to 11 for Jeanty, but Jeanty's involvement in the passing game helped compensate for the limited rushing volume. The second-year running back remains an RB1 heading into Week 12 against Cleveland. This was what we needed to see from Jeanty.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Fernando Mendoza throws three touchdowns in Week 11
items.desc: Fernando Mendoza completed 18 of 37 passes for 267 yards, three touchdowns and one interception while rushing four times for 22 yards in the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 11.
items.impact: Mendoza threw the first three touchdown passes of his career, connecting with Ashton Jeanty, Ian Thomas and Jack Bech. The rookie helped the Raiders erase a 17-point deficit but was sacked five times and threw a pick-six late in the fourth quarter. All things considered, Mendoza put together a productive fantasy performance against a difficult matchup in his second career start. He enters the QB2 conversation in Superflex leagues heading into Week 12 against Cleveland.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Broncos D/ST scores touchdown in Week 11
items.desc: The Broncos' defense allowed 24 points and 370 total yards while recording five sacks, one interception and one defensive touchdown in Denver's 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
items.impact: Denver allowed three touchdown passes to rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza but also sacked him five times. And with the Broncos protecting a seven-point lead late in the fourth quarter, cornerback Ja'Quan McMillian returned an interception 35 yards for a touchdown. The sacks and defensive touchdown made up for the yardage and points allowed. Denver remains a must-start D/ST heading into Week 12 against Pittsburgh, leaving fantasy managers that dropped them during the bye down bad.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Wil Lutz makes all six kicks in Week 11
items.desc: Wil Lutz converted his lone field-goal attempt and all five extra-point attempts in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
items.impact: Lutz connected from 38 yards out in the first quarter. Denver scored touchdowns on five of its six scoring possessions, limiting Lutz to one field-goal attempt despite scoring a season-high 38 points. He'll get the Steelers on the road in Week 12.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Adam Trautman scores touchdown in Week 11
items.desc: Adam Trautman caught his only target for a one-yard touchdown in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
items.impact: Trautman caught Bo Nix's lone touchdown pass Sunday. That said, Evan Engram caught six of eight targets for 74 yards, while Trautman was targeted once. The touchdown doesn't change the hierarchy of Denver's tight end room from a fantasy perspective. Trautman can remain on waivers.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Evan Engram leads Denver in receiving in Week 11
items.desc: Evan Engram caught six of eight targets for 74 yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
items.impact: Engram led Denver in receptions, targets and receiving yards Sunday. The tight end had two receiving yards between Weeks 7 and 8 but has since caught 10 passes for 107 yards over his last two games. So, there are signs of life here. Engram is back in the streaming conversation heading into Week 12 against Pittsburgh.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Troy Franklin held without a catch in Week 11
items.desc: Troy Franklin failed to catch either of his two targets in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
items.impact: Franklin had three receptions for 31 yards in Week 9 before being held without a catch Sunday. Meanwhile, Jaylen Waddle, Evan Engram and Pat Bryant combined for 167 of Bo Nix's 225 passing yards. Franklin is expendable in most redraft leagues.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. totals 47 yards in Week 11
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. caught one of two targets for 36 yards while rushing once for 11 yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
items.impact: Mims accounted for Denver's longest offensive play of the game, catching a 36-yard pass from Bo Nix on a flea-flicker. The problem? That was his only reception. Mims continues to make the most of his limited opportunities, but three touches aren't enough to warrant a fantasy start.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Pat Bryant catches three passes in Week 11
items.desc: Pat Bryant caught three of four targets for 32 yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.Bryant followed his 56-yard, one-touchdown performance in Week 9 with 32 receiving yards Sunday. He saw four targets compared to six for Jaylen Waddle and two for Courtland Sutton. Bryant is carving out a role in Denver's passing attack, but four targets aren't enough to warrant a fantasy start in most leagues.
items.impact: Bryant followed his 56-yard, one-touchdown performance in Week 9 with 32 receiving yards Sunday. He saw four targets compared to six for Jaylen Waddle and two for Courtland Sutton. Bryant is carving out a role in Denver's passing attack, but four targets aren't enough to warrant a fantasy start in most leagues.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Courtland Sutton held without a catch in Week 11
items.desc: Courtland Sutton failed to catch either of his two targets in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
items.impact: Sutton led Denver with nine targets in Week 9, albeit in a game Jaylen Waddle exited with a concussion. With the latter back in the lineup Sunday, Sutton saw just two targets. The Broncos scored a season-high 38 points, and Sutton didn't factor into the scoring. He's difficult to justify rostering in standard-sized fantasy leagues.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Jaylen Waddle records 61 receiving yards in Week 11
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle caught three of six targets for 61 yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
items.impact: Waddle returned from the concussion he suffered in Week 9 and averaged 20.3 yards per reception Sunday. He led Denver's wide receivers in targets, receptions and receiving yards. That said, three of Denver's four offensive touchdowns came on the ground. Waddle remains the Broncos only wide receiver to start in fantasy heading into Week 12 against Pittsburgh.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: J.K. Dobbins limited to one carry in Week 11
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins rushed once for zero yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
items.impact: Dobbins had seven carries in Week 8 and just one Sunday. Meanwhile, rookie running back Jonah Coleman set career highs in carries (24), rushing yards (111) and rushing touchdowns (three) against Las Vegas. The Broncos' backfield belongs to Coleman, leaving Dobbins with little fantasy value outside of being the former's lottery ticket handcuff.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Jonah Coleman rushes for three touchdowns in Week 11
items.desc: Jonah Coleman rushed 24 times for 111 yards and three touchdowns, while catching four of five targets for 18 yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
items.impact: Coleman set career highs in carries, rushing yards and rushing touchdowns Sunday. The rookie has now scored five rushing touchdowns over his last three games and caught four passes in each game over that stretch. Meanwhile, J.K. Dobbins had one carry for zero yards against Las Vegas. There's no longer much ambiguity regarding Denver's backfield. Coleman is an RB1 heading into Week 12 against Pittsburgh. League winner.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Bo Nix throws one touchdown in Week 11
items.desc: Bo Nix completed 19 of 35 passes for 225 yards, one touchdown and one interception while rushing six times for five yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
items.impact: The Broncos scored a season-high 38 points, but three of their five touchdowns came on the ground via Jonah Coleman -- while another came on defense. Nix, meanwhile, threw just one touchdown after throwing two in each of his previous two games. The Broncos quarterback will look to rebound against the Steelers in Week 12.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alex Highsmith (ankle) not expected to play in Week 12
items.desc: Alex Highsmith is not expected to play in Week 12 against the Broncos.
items.impact: Highsmith suffered a left ankle injury in Sunday's loss to the Eagles. "It's going to be tough for him to make it this week," Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaycee Horn (quad) remains week-to-week
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said DB Jaycee Horn is week-to-week.
items.impact: Canales said they need to go day-to-day with Horn. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

items.impact: Zappe was one of three quarterbacks who the Colts worked out. They'll likely sign someone this week to add to the quarterback room after Daniel Jones was released.

items.title: Charles Cross (ankle) practices Monday
items.desc: Charles Cross was at practice on Monday.
items.impact: Cross was banged up going into the bye week for Seattle. He will need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Leonard Williams (stinger) at practice Monday
items.desc: Leonard Williams was at practice for the Seahawks on Monday.
items.impact: Williams was sidelined for a couple weeks in a row prior to the bye for Seattle. He will need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Darnold (quad/rib) to start in Week 12 if healthy
items.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said the plan remains for Sam Darnold to start in Week 12 against the 49ers.
items.impact: Macdonald clarified that nothing is official yet. Darnold was at practice on Monday to begin the week. He will need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.
